p: Know thou assuredly: Though it was a great grief to David to fight against the people of God, yet such was his infirmity, he did not dare deny him.
put away those that had familiar: According to the commandment of God, Ex 22:18, De 18:10,11.
Urim: Meaning, the high priest, Ex 28:30.
disguised himself: He does not seek God in his misery, but is led by Satan to unlawful means, which in his conscience he condemns.
Samuel: He speaks according to his gross ignorance not considering the state of the saints after this life, and how Satan has no power over them.
Samuel: To his imagination, even though it was Satan, who to blind his eyes took on him the form of Samuel, as he can do of an angel of light.
and to morrow shalt thou and: You will die, 1Sa 31:6.
afraid: The wicked when they hear God's judgments, tremble and despair, but cannot seek for mercy by repentance.
have put my life in my: I have ventured my life.
unleavened bread thereof: Because it required haste.
